name: tech.aspid.fasttools
description: Unity tools to cut boilerplate — source-generated ProfilerMarkers, serializable type/enum systems, SerializeReference tooling and a fluent UIToolkit API.

samples.description: An enemy spawner storing three System.Types: SerializableMonoScript<T> (rename-safe), SerializableType<T> with [TypeSelectorDisplay] candidates, a member-referenced [TypeSelector] and ComponentTypeSelector to swap a component in place.

A turret firing polymorphic [SerializeReference] weapons at a dummy: the [TypeSelector] picker on single fields, lists, narrowed, nested and generic fields, plus deliberately broken assets for Fix, Smart Fix, Migrate all and the References tabs, and an IMGUI inspector.

A character walking over surface tiles: EnumValues<TEnum, TValue> on a palette asset, EnumValues<TValue> with a [Flags] enum picked in the Inspector, default values and the flags lookup rules in action.
A flock simulation with this.Marker() around each phase: the generated marker tree in the Profiler, per-iteration markers, markers in plain classes and local functions.

An editor window and a custom inspector built in code: fluent VisualElement extensions, ListView and binding, SerializedProperty setters, GetScriptName, AddOpenScriptCommand and TypeSelectorWindow as a public API.
